title: The hornbill nest guardians
caption:
Ten nest protectors, about 40 nests, 220 chicks.

Nest protectors are Nyishi villagers from ten villages who find, monitor and guard nest trees through the breeding season.

Source: Nature Conservation Foundation; BirdLife International / IUCN Red List; Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
